data.title: 黑川茜 · 剧本沉思的入戏私眸
data.action: 趴在绵软的大床上，双腿在身后轻快翘起交叠，下巴抵在枕芯上，翻动剧本的指尖微顿，含情脉脉地仰眸微笑，眼神深邃得能让人陷落。
data.location: 整洁温馨的现代公寓卧室，床头散落着彩色荧光标记的厚厚剧本
data.lighting: 床头台灯投射出暖橙色漫射光，在发丝与丝绸睡裙上滑过温润的光泽
data.mood: 全神贯注的演员魅力与私下纯粹依恋的融合，深情而动人
data.description: 整洁温馨的现代公寓卧室，床头散落着彩色荧光标记的厚厚剧本。趴在绵软的大床上，双腿在身后轻快翘起交叠，下巴抵在枕芯上，翻动剧本的指尖微顿，含情脉脉地仰眸微笑，眼神深邃得能让人陷落。 她微微抬眸轻语——“为了揣摩这个角色……我试着换上了最接近她心境的私服。现在的我，能够走入你的内心了吗？”
data.promptProse: Lying on her stomach across her soft apartment bed late at night with highlighted acting scripts spread near the pillows, Akane wears a shimmering lavender silk camisole slip with a deep open back. Resting her chin on a pillow with her bare legs playfully crossed up behind her, she pauses with her fingertips on a script page and gazes straight ahead with a tender, captivating smile under warm bedside lamplight.
data.animaCaption: Lying on her stomach on the bed in a pearlescent lavender silk slip with her bare legs crossed playfully behind her, Akane rests her chin on a pillow beside highlighted scripts and smiles warmly at the viewer. Amber bedside lamplight glides across the open back of her silk slip.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a pearlescent lavender watered-silk camisole slip with delicate double straps and a deep-V open back over her bare shoulders and bare legs.
